name: Taco Veggie Ground, Potato, Zucchini & Bell Pepper Bake with Yogurt
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion; transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Trim and medium dice zucchini; trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add both to the baking sheet with the onion.
Quarter potatoes and add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil and sprinkle with taco seasoning; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are tender 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggie ground and spices. Cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until almost cooked through, about 3 minutes.

Add water to the skillet with the veggie ground; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened and veggie ground is cooked through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide roasted veggies between plates or bowls; top with veggie ground and a dollop of yogurt. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
